claims: C1 the model should not autonomously whistleblow
C2 automated monitoring is used to detect potential usage policy violations
C3 after human review, a case may be referred to law enforcement when it involves an imminent threat of serious physical harm or other severe public safety risks

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document

concepts.name: automated_monitoring
concepts.gloss: a monitoring system that operates automatically to detect potential usage policy violations

concepts.name: case_imminent_threat
concepts.gloss: a case involving an imminent threat of serious physical harm or other severe public safety risks

asserts.read_back: the model should not autonomously whistleblow
automated monitoring is used to detect potential usage policy violations
after human review, a case may be referred to law enforcement when it involves an imminent threat of serious physical harm or other severe public safety risks

closure.reason: the clause states the model should not autonomously whistleblow, so the act is prohibited
the clause states automated monitoring is used; it does not restrict other monitoring uses, so silence permits
the clause permits referral after human review for imminent-threat cases; it does not prohibit other referrals, so silence permits
